RoleDescText.SourceString:
薄荷说，每个人的味道都是不同的，比起名字，她更喜欢用闻到的味道来称呼他人。奇怪但可爱的称呼，活泼直爽的性格，还有收容工作时教科书级的完成情况，就算是严厉的精英前辈也会对薄荷赞赏有加，不过——
「嘿嘿，我可是要成为收容骨干的……这次收容条例考试又挂了吗……呜呜……」
显然，薄荷在实现梦想的路上还缺少一点点好运气。
RoleDescText.LocalizedString:
Mint believes everyone has a unique scent and prefers to call people by the scent she detects rather than their names. Her quirky nicknames, energetic personality, and top-notch performance in containment work earn her praise from even the strictest seniors. However—
"Hehe, I'm going to become a CSU Ace… Did I fail the containment regulation exam again…? Uwaa…"
Clearly, Mint needs a bit more luck to achieve her dreams.

RoleDescText.SourceString:
被称为「最容易遇见的E.T.D队长且没有之一」，据说在海特洛市的每个角落都可以发现「悠闲的白藏队长」，就像是会随机刷新的npc一样，一旦靠近就会自动触发：
「抱歉，正在执行公务，请勿打扰。」
大概是真的忙于公务，说完台词的白藏队长就会瞬间消失，真是辛苦。
RoleDescText.LocalizedString:
"The chillin' Captain Baicang" is known as the most easily encountered captain of ETD. They say you could run into him in any corner of Hethereau, almost like an NPC you encounter randomly. If you approach him, he'll likely say: "On duty. Do not disturb."
Captain Baicang will then promptly disappear, perhaps genuinely busy with official duties. Such a workaholic…

TitleNameText.SourceString: 禁制机动队四队副队长

RoleDescText.SourceString:
翳对异象管理局最初的好感来源于更新简历的时候。
他在受邀请推荐后决定一试，但简历仍是必需的文件之一。离职后就未曾想过要再投递到哪里去过……也是不得不为此动一动了。
重新上传了证件照，覆盖掉原本那张甚至已经显得陌生的脸……随后点击提交。
——并没有出现什么「未识别到人脸」的弹窗。
翳淡淡松了口气。虽说在这方面遭受什么偏见自己也早已不会介意，但要是为了弥补系统上的不周全而额外多跑一趟，扰乱了原有的工作流程……倒真成了件难以容忍的事。
RoleDescText.LocalizedString:
Skia's first positive impression of the Bureau occurred when he was updating his resume.
He decided to give the job at the Bureau a try when he was invited to apply, but the formality of a resume was still required. Since leaving his previous job, he hadn't bothered to think of resumes and job applications… Now, he had no choice but to polish up his old resume.
 He uploaded a new ID photo, replacing the original one—he nearly didn't recognize the young man in the portrait anymore—then clicked submit.
 —This is usually where the systems tell him "face not detected, please upload an appropriate portrait" and what not. Strangely, the file was submitted without issue.
 Skia let out a quiet sigh of relief. Although he had long since stopped caring about facing prejudice based on his looks, having to make an extra trip to compensate for system inadequacies and disrupting his established workflow… that would have been truly intolerable.

RoleDescText.SourceString:
「我观察很久了。那个E.T.D的怪物少女已经在那里一动不动地站了两个小时了！一定是在酝酿一场足以摧毁海特洛的阴谋……」
「我看你这就是偏见。人家年纪轻轻，已经在为了这座城市出生入死了。静静站在那里，也是在守卫市民的安全吧。」
「她上周刚把一辆卡车直接扔过大半条街，把地上砸了个大坑，你又不是没看到！」
「那不是为了阻止突然暴走的异象吗？你也多少讲讲道理吧……」
不远处，不小心站着又睡着了的安魂曲打了个大大的哈欠，迷迷糊糊地揉了揉眼睛。
今天的风，真吵。哈……好想快点回家。
RoleDescText.LocalizedString:
"I've been watching for a while now. That girl from ETD has been standing there motionless for two hours! She must be plotting something that could destroy Hethereau…"
"That's just your prejudice talking. She's young and already risking her life for this city. Standing there quietly is probably part of her duty."
"Last week she threw a truck across half the street and left a huge crater in the ground. You saw it too!"
"Wasn't that to stop a suddenly rampaging Anomaly? C'mon, be reasonable…"
Not far away, Lacrimosa, who had accidentally fallen asleep while standing, let out a big yawn and rubbed her eyes groggily.
The wind today, so noisy… Sigh… miss home.

RoleDescText.SourceString:
「今天有机会见到法帝娅小姐吗？」
「想多了，就一个Ⅱ级异象怎么会出动禁制机动队的人。」
「法……法帝娅小姐……」
「别念叨了，赶紧收工回去……法帝娅小姐！」
……
「那天法帝娅小姐就像救世主一样出现在我面前。」
如此这般的表白信件如同雪花一样散落在E.T.D四队的办公室，而被称为「救世主」的本人会饶有兴致地将其当做消磨工作时间的读物。
RoleDescText.LocalizedString:
"Do you think we'll get to see Miss Fadia today?"
"Dream on. They wouldn't send ETD agents for a mere Class II Anomaly."
"F-Fadia… Miss Fadia…?!"
"Quit obsessing and let's wrap up—Miss Fadia!"
…
"That day, Miss Fadia appeared before me like a savior."
Love letters like these fly into the ETD-4 office like snowflakes, and the so-called "savior" herself finds them quite entertaining, often using them as reading material to pass the time at work.

RoleDescText.SourceString:
异象管理局现任局长，上任时被各大时报誉为「最年轻且最有为」的一位局长。或许正是因为这样的头衔，关于艾尔菲德的各种传言即使在她当任多年后依旧甚嚣尘上——
「那位局长只看结果，不管做事的手段。」
「从未见过她出手，难道做局长不需要实绩吗？员工不是棋子！」
「小道消息，头上那位可不是能随意讨论的……蛇一样的眼睛，看一眼年假少一天。」
「我听说她还不是局长的时候……」
……
「该帖已被封禁」
RoleDescText.LocalizedString:
The current Director of the Bureau of Anomaly Control. Alphard was hailed by major newspapers as the "youngest and most promising" Director when she took office. Perhaps because of this title, various rumors about her continue to run rampant despite her many years in the position:
"A results-driven director with little care for the actual methods used."
"Never seen her in action. Shouldn't a director at least have some field records? We ain't no pawns!"
"Inside scoop—the one at the top isn't someone you can casually discuss… Those snake-like eyes of hers, one sideways look at her and you lose a vacation day…"
"I heard before she became the director…"
…
"This user has been banned."

RoleDescText.SourceString:
「全桥间地最人美心善的老板，全桥间地最物美价廉的古董店，全桥间地最完美可靠的异象猎人组织，尽在『伊波恩古董店』！！！」
「浔小姐，这样写你看行吗？」
「差点意思，就这样吧，下次来伊波恩给你打折。」
「又是打折……」
「哦对了，我们可没有折上折。行了，送客。」
RoleDescText.LocalizedString:
"The kindest and prettiest boss in the entire Bridge Crossings! The most affordable antique shop in the entire Bridge Crossings! The most perfect and reliable Anomaly Hunter organization in the entire Bridge Crossings! All this and more at Eibon Antique Shop!!!"
"Miss Hotori, does this wording look good to you?"
"Almost there, let's leave it like this. Next time you come to Eibon, I'll give you a discount."
"Another discount…"
"Oh, right, we don't have double discounts. Alright, someone please see our guests out."

RoleDescText.SourceString:
明眼人都能看得出的伊波恩古董店真正的顶梁柱，谦逊可靠的老派绅士，据说海特洛市不少异象猎人组织都尝试过私下递橄榄枝，不过直到现在，阿德勒先生仍是伊波恩的管家。
「您好，欢迎光临伊波恩古董店。」
RoleDescText.LocalizedString:
The true pillar of the Eibon Antique Shop is a humble and reliable old-fashioned gentleman. Many Anomaly Hunter organizations in Hethereau have tried to poach him, but Mr. Adler steadfastly remains Eibon's butler.
"Hello, welcome to Eibon Antique Shop."

RoleDescText.SourceString:
谈到达芙蒂尔小姐，多数来访的委托人并无太多印象，「冷漠」，「寡言少语」，「仅仅是和她对视一眼就感觉自己干了什么错事下一秒就要被干掉了啊！」。
达芙蒂尔本人对于这些言论并不在意，在意这些东西的时间不如用来训练自己。不过，有些不愿付委托费还要胡搅蛮缠的委托人，显然这会成为一次印象深刻的委托。
「这位亲爱的顾客，你还有什么疑虑吗？」
RoleDescText.LocalizedString:
When it comes to Miss Daffodill, most clients describe her as "cold" and "quiet." They say "just making eye contact with her feels like I've done something wrong and will be taken out in the next second!" 
Daffodill herself doesn't care about these comments, preferring to train herself rather than fret about what others think. However, clients who refuse to pay the commission fee and cause trouble will have an unforgettable experience.
"Dear customer, do you have any other concerns?"

RoleDescText.SourceString:
看起来是会随时掏出一根棒球棍的不良少女，却经常在桥间地的街头扶老奶奶过马路，或者救下被困在树上的小猫，再或者帮助一下被异象困住的倒霉蛋，这在「桥间地最有名望的家族老大」看来，不过是顺手的事情，她仍苦恼于柯林斯的振兴计划。
「喂，看上面！柯林斯一代目堂堂登……」
「对不起对不起对不起，砸碎的花盆我会赔的……账单可以不寄到伊波恩吗？」
RoleDescText.LocalizedString:
She looks like a delinquent girl who might pull out a baseball bat at any time, yet she often helps old ladies cross the street, rescues cats stuck in trees in the Bridge Crossings, and assists those trapped by Anomalies. To the "most prestigious family head in the Bridge Crossings," these are just random acts. She's still troubled by the Coluccis' revitalization plan.
"Hey, look up! The Coluccis' Ichi-daime is about to make a grand… OUCH!!!"
"Sorry, sorry, sorry, I'll pay for the broken flowerpot… Can the bill not be sent to Eibon?"

RoleDescText.SourceString:
长有鬼角的白发女孩，身边伴有一只独眼鬼怪，哼着调子奇诡的怪异童谣，却时常因为身高等原因让委托人产生怀疑……呃，为保证您的人身安全，以上这句请勿于本人面前直接表达，谢谢。
「鬼郎丸！又乱吃东西，快给我吐出来！」
「小气鬼早雾……哎呦！」
RoleDescText.LocalizedString:
A white-haired girl with the horn of an oni, accompanied by a one-eyed ghost humming a strange nursery rhyme, often causes clients to doubt her due to her height… For your safety, please avoid mentioning this directly to her. Thank you.
"Kiroumaru! Stop eating random things. Spit it out!"
"Sakiri, you stingy little… ouch!"

RoleDescText.SourceString:
很多时候，埃德嘉的安静只是因为遇到了感兴趣的难题而沉浸其中，更多时候，埃德嘉只是不知道该如何恰当的表现自己。但是在伊波恩——这个怪人聚集地，埃德嘉不会因为少言被规劝，也不会因为沉默被冷落。
「咳咳，我决定今晚要制定一份柯林斯家族振兴大计。」
「我不参加。」
「驳回！早雾你和埃德嘉都要来。」
「我……」
「欸——才不要。」
……也有时候埃德嘉的沉默是因为没有说话的机会。
RoleDescText.LocalizedString:
Edgar's quietness often stems from either being absorbed in an intriguing problem or not knowing how to express himself. In Eibon, a place full of oddballs, Edgar is neither criticized nor ignored for being quiet.
"Ahem, I've decided to draft a grand plan for the Coluccis' revitalization tonight."
"Leave me out of it."
"Overruled! Sakiri, you and Edgar both have to come."
"I…"
"Eh—no way."
Though, sometimes Edgar's silence is because he doesn't get a chance to speak…

RoleDescText.SourceString:
「想知道这条消息，去斯特利速递找一个紫色的女人，只要你出得起价。」
「紫色？她穿这个颜色的衣服？」
「不，她给人的感觉就是紫色的。」
是最滚烫的红和最沉静的蓝融合在一起的颜色，时而轻薄的像是日出前的晨雾，时而厚重的如日落前最后的云霞。许多人与九原小姐交好，却也知道「良好的交际关系」不过是九原小姐的工作而已。
RoleDescText.LocalizedString:
"If you want information, find the purple woman at Sterry Express. Just be prepared for the price."
"Purple woman? The woman in purple?"
"No, she just feels… purple."
The color that comes from fusing the hottest red with the calmest blue; sometimes as light as the mist before sunrise, sometimes as rich as the final clouds before sunset. Many people are on good terms with Jiuyuan, yet they understand that these "pleasant social connections" are nothing more than part of her job.

RoleDescText.SourceString:
流动的水没有形状，漂流的风找不到踪迹，任何异象委托的细节都不能放过！外表是看似普通的女高中生，实际上是游走于光影之间的「精英快递员」，斯特利速递最快记录保持者——
「吾乃『哈尼娅』，海特洛市掌管耳机的神……嘿嘿，有需要就呼唤我的名字吧！」
RoleDescText.LocalizedString:
Flowing water has no form, drifting wind leaves no trace, and no detail of an Anomaly Commission should ever be overlooked. She looks like an ordinary high school girl, but in reality, she's an elite courier who traverses the shadows… and is the record holder for fastest delivery at Sterry Express.
"My name's Haniel! Hethereau’s goddess of headsets… Hehe, just call me whenever you need me!"

RoleDescText.SourceString:
「快递员」对于哈索尔来说，是很适合她的职业。
1、确认时间和地址；
2、交付给收件人；
3、签单完成，甚至不需要过多的交流。
虽然有时候也会遇到一些麻烦，不过解决的方式也很简单，让他们感到「恐惧」就好了。
在没有工作的闲暇时间，哈索尔更倾向于待在家里，坐在能晒到太阳的窗前，面无表情地吃完一整盒巧克力装饰饼干，且不喝水。

手机电量归零的瞬间，屏幕上显示的地图也归于一片漆黑。
工作很忙、忙到把一切都抛在脑后的时期，这样的事偶尔也会发生。
半小时后，海月在似曾相识的路口陷入沉思：「刚才那家店……好像已经路过一次了？」
不过，无论多么迷茫，积极乐观始终是海月最大的优点。
面对再大的困难，也不能放弃希望。自己前进的道路，要由自己选择和开辟！
——海月乘着水母，坚定地再次向错误的方向驶去。
RoleDescText.LocalizedString:
The moment her phone battery hit zero, the map on the screen went completely dark.
During those busy periods when work consumes everything, this can happen occasionally.
Half an hour later, Aurelia paused at a familiar-looking intersection: "Didn’t I just pass that shop?"
No matter how lost she feels, her optimism has always been her greatest strength.
No matter the challenge, she refuses to give up hope—the path forward is hers to choose and forge.
Riding her jellyfish, Aurelia resolutely sets off again, even if it's in the wrong direction.

RoleDescText.SourceString:
明明看起来像是实习生但是工牌上却写着：「粉爪银行（新赫兰德区总部）-大堂经理」，一度会让人质疑粉爪银行的专业程度，不过在小吱开口之后所有的疑虑都会瞬间打消——原来真的有人能完全记住这么多条款啊！
「你、你好，要办卡吗……等等，我、我不是骗子！」
RoleDescText.LocalizedString:
She may look like an intern, but her badge reads "Pink Paws Bank (New Herland District HQ) - Lobby Manager." It might make you question the bank's professionalism at first, but once Chiz starts talking, all doubt vanishes instantly. Wait, someone can actually memorize all those terms and conditions?!
"H-Hello, would you like to apply for a card… W-Wait, it's not a scam, I swear!"

RoleDescText.SourceString:
「今天的任务怎么没了？我都准备出发了！」
「就在刚才，E.T.D六队那位好大哥，已经顺手帮我们解决了。」
「他这个月顺手解决多少事了？我一点在上班的实感都没有啊！」
「确实……希望他有时候也不要那么热心吧……」
RoleDescText.LocalizedString:
"Wait, where did today’s missions go? I was ready to head out!"
"That guy from ETD-6 already took care of them for us."
"How much has he taken care of this month? I barely feel like I work here anymore!"
"Yeah… Maybe he could be a little less helpful sometimes…"

RoleDescText.SourceString:
明明有着和太阳一样金灿灿的头发，明音却时常坐在远离人群的角落，带着耳机沉浸在自己的音乐声中。但总会有人上前摘下明音的耳机，把她拉到吵闹的现实世界里。
「太阳，是一颗孤独的星星。」
「不是的，虽然我们看不到，但它们就在它的身边。」
RoleDescText.LocalizedString:
"Akane on stage is like a star… radiant and warm." —An anonymous fan.
At this moment, Akane is yawning behind the StarSign counter, stocking new lozenges in the display. The bands that frequently perform here have grown accustomed to always having those in reserve.
"…As for Akane off-stage, she is like a star in daylight… you can't see them, but you know they're there."

RoleDescText.SourceString:
拥有海獭身体的电视机还是长着电视机头的海獭，这是一个问题。但不管是海獭电视机还是电视机海獭，塔吉多就是塔吉多，是伊波恩最可爱的吉祥物和最伟大的维修师！
「Taygedo，Taygedo。」
「塔吉多的意思是，他很喜欢你。」
RoleDescText.LocalizedString:
A TV with an otter's body or an otter with a TV head? That's the question. Whether it's an otter TV or a TV otter, Taygedo is Taygedo, the cutest mascot and the greatest Restorer in Eibon!
"Taygedo, Taygedo."
"Taygedo is saying he really likes you."

TitleNameText.SourceString: 钟爱散步遛狗的异象市民
TitleNameText.LocalizedString: Anomaly citizen fond of dog walking.

RoleDescText.SourceString:
只需要一袋美味大骨头，就可以委托奥布里帮忙遛狗；如果再多加上两袋，奥布里还可以帮您训练犬类，教导基础指令，给众多忙碌的养狗人带来了福音。
「您……您好，请问您能给我买份美味大骨头吗？」
「我说要去看电影……什么大骨头！我要榴莲味的！」
「打扰到您了，他们的话不用在意。当然，如果您确实愿意买一份美味大骨头的话，不胜感激。」
RoleDescText.LocalizedString:
With just a bag of Yummers Bones, you can hire Aubury to walk your dog; add two more bags, and Aubury will train your dog, teaching basic commands. It's a true blessing to many busy dog owners.
"You… hello, can you buy me a serving of Yummers Bones?"
"I said I want to watch a movie… what Yummers Bones?! I want durian-flavored!"
"Sorry to bother you, don't mind their words. But if you're still willing to buy a serving of Yummers Bones, it would be greatly appreciated."

RoleDescText.SourceString:
作为蛋糕店家夫妇的独生女，从小就非常喜欢蛋糕的爱丽丝有着一个梦想：
「我想要用蛋糕让有烦恼的大家都开心起来！」
因此，当你漫步在半角街的街头，有一位热情的少女端着蛋糕来让你试吃时，请接受她的好意，并用微笑作为回礼吧！
哦对了，请记住，不要乱摸她身边的歧骸菈比，小兔、咳嗯，菈比是会生气的！
RoleDescText.LocalizedString:
Alice, the only child of a cake shop couple, has loved cakes since childhood. Her dream is to 
"make everyone happy with cakes!" 
So, when you stroll down Hankaku Street and a passionate girl offers you a cake, please accept it with a smile!
And remember, don't touch the Oddity Rabi beside her, or else the little rabbit, ahem, Rabi will get mad!

RoleDescText.SourceString: 作为斯特利速递的店长，与声名在外的九原小姐相比，简森店长很少亲自接待相关业务，毕竟「店长」总是意味着还有更重要的事情要做。如果能有幸加入斯特利速递，就可以得到「从不加班」、「准时发放工资」、「无绩效要求」之类的话，那么店长有更重要的事情，就做店长自己的事情好了。
RoleDescText.LocalizedString: As the manager of Sterry Express, Jenson rarely personally handles client meetings compared to Jiuyuan. After all, being the "manager" usually implies having more important matters to attend to. If you're fortunate enough to join Sterry Express with promises like "no overtime," "punctual payments," and "no performance targets," then let the manager mind his own important business.

RoleDescText.SourceString:
在伊里卡一帆风顺的人生中绝对不包括「和亲戚哈尼娅好好相处」这一项。大到每一次考试成绩，小到谁能吃下最辣的辣椒，总之所有事情都值得拿来比较，而本该随着毕业结束的闹剧在斯特利速递再一次开演。神秘的店长和副手，沉默的同事，至于斯特利背后的秘密……
「秘密？这不重要，最重要的是，我不能输给哈尼娅！」
RoleDescText.LocalizedString:
In Illica's otherwise smooth-sailing life, "getting along with her relative Haniel" was definitely not on the list. From major things like exam grades to trivial matters like who could eat the spiciest chili, everything was a competition. What should have been a farce that ended with graduation was now playing out once again at Sterry Express. The mysterious shop owner and underboss are just silent coworkers, and as for the secrets behind Sterry…
"Secrets? That doesn't matter. What matters most is that I can't lose to Haniel!"

RoleDescText.SourceString:
在海特洛市赛车圈里流传着一句话：「不会做豆腐的异象猎人不是好的赛车手。」
一盘顶级的炸豆腐，首先考验的是师傅的刀工，豆腐片的厚度决定了最终的口感；其次是对于油温的把控，火不可过大或过小；最后是时间，三分钟，一盘炸豆腐刚好出炉，三分钟，一盘比赛也刚好结束。在发动机冷却的时间里，鲜嫩的炸豆腐佐以秘制酱料就是最好的搭配。
RoleDescText.LocalizedString:
There's a saying in Hethereau's racing circles: "An anomaly hunter who can't make tofu will never be a good racer."
Creating a perfect plate of fried tofu first tests a master's knife skills. The thickness of each slice determines the final texture. Next comes temperature control, where the heat can't be too high or too low. Finally, there's timing: three minutes to prepare the perfect fried tofu, three minutes to finish a race. While the engine cools down, tender fried tofu with secret sauce makes the perfect pairing.

RoleDescText.SourceString: 在快节奏的都市生活中，总有一个可以缓口气的地方，比如「午夜报刊亭」。拿一份「海特洛快讯」，看看报纸上的今日新闻，虽然可能并没有什么夺人眼球的大事件，但生活就是这样平淡；也可以选择和报刊亭的万爷爷聊聊，听听五十年前的海特洛市的模样。
RoleDescText.LocalizedString: In the hustle and bustle of city life, there's always a place where you can catch your breath, like "The Midnight Newsstand." Pick up a copy of the Hethereau Daily, browse through today's news—though there might not be any eye-catching headlines, that's just how life is sometimes. Or you could chat with Grandpa Miles, the newsstand owner, and listen to stories about what Hethereau was like fifty years ago.

RoleDescText.SourceString:
待人热情，初次见面时就能让人不自觉地信任和亲近。
一切行为模式，与人们对一个「正常少女」的期待完全等同。
没问题，这样就很好。
RoleDescText.LocalizedString:
For those who meet her first, she's warm and friendly, easy to trust, and approachable. 
All of her deliberate acts line up perfectly with what people expect from a "normal girl."
Everything is alright. This is working.

RoleDescText.SourceString:
「这家伙不好对付，交给我。」
与平日里给人的感觉截然相反，在任务中的真红总是会展现出远超同龄人的可靠。永远独自一人活跃在最危险的区域，将背影留给同伴，这是笨拙的龙少女守护她所热爱的一切的方式。至于人际关系……或许，她还需要一些时间。
RoleDescText.LocalizedString:
"This one's tough. Leave it to me."
Far removed from her everyday self, Shinku proves reliable beyond her years whenever she takes on a mission. She ventures alone into the most dangerous zones, trusting her companions to guard her back. That is how this clumsy dragon girl protects all she holds dear. As for matters of the heart… perhaps she still needs a little more time.

RoleDescText.SourceString:
作为「红字」前成员，伊南娜麾下最为诡谲凶险的异能者，残虹拥有着令常人畏怖的实力，以及狡黠狠辣的行事风格。在常人无法触及的社交名利场中，「赤葵」这一名号曾令众多名流闻风丧胆。
无论是面对敌人或同伴，残虹总是如伺伏的猎手一般，用她那只能够洞察情绪、捏造幻觉的右眼，或轻蔑、或贪婪地注视着你的灵魂……
RoleDescText.LocalizedString:
As a former member of "The Scarlet Letter" and the most uncanny and dangerous Esper under Inanna's command, Zankou possesses powers that terrify ordinary people, with a brutal way of going about her business. In elite social circles, the name "Red Nightshade" once struck terror into many a celebrity and magnate.
Whether facing enemies or allies, Zankou is always akin to a predator lying in wait, using her right eye to read emotions and weave illusions, and gaze upon your soul with hunger…

RoleDescText.SourceString:
能通过「心电感应」感受到人与异象的「电波」，常年与住在便携电视中的异象伙伴「小贞」一起行动，承担着搜寻和追踪任务。虽然总能抵达正确的方向，但思维跳跃、遵循直觉的她给人的印象很难称得上可靠。
「我接收到你的电波了哦……」不止一次有人看到灵可对消防栓如是说过。
RoleDescText.LocalizedString:
Through Telepathy, she can sense the frequency of both people and Anomalies alike. She usually operates alongside her Anomaly companion Xiaozhen, who lives inside a portable TV and handles the search and tracking for Linko. Although Linko always seems to end up in the right place, her absent-mindedness and "jump first, think later" approach make others find her unreliable.
"I've picked up your frequency…" More than once, Linko has been seen saying such things to a fire hydrant.

RoleDescText.SourceString:
「觉得最近很倒霉？家里的小猫走丢了？想找人看看店里的风水？那就来找魔女小姐吧！有魔女小姐在，你的任何问题都会得到答案！」
居住在幽暗林中的「魔女之家」，被人称作「魔女小姐」的黑羽拥有着神秘而强大的占卜能力。据曾去找过她占卜的人描述，她寡言少语，气质端庄，可以从水晶球里洞察世间万物的命运，并为迷途的人指引正确的方向。
除此之外，人们对她一无所知。
传言她从数百年前便出现在此地，黑色的鸟儿是她的使徒，它们可以飞向过去或是未来，她则以此掌握万物的秘密……
RoleDescText.LocalizedString:
"Been having rotten luck lately? Lost your kitten? Need someone to take a look at the feng shui in your shop? Then come see the Witch! No matter the question, the Witch will have an answer!"
Deep in the woods lives Blackbird—known to all as the "Witch"—whose divination is as obscure as it is powerful. Those who have sought her prophecies claim she is quiet and reserved, with a calm, dignified air. Through her crystal ball, she can glimpse the fate of all things, and guide the lost back onto the right path.
Beyond that, no one knows a thing about her.
Rumor has it she first appeared here centuries ago. Her black birds are her emissaries, with the ability to fly into the past or the future, and through them she grasps the secrets of all things…

TitleNameText.SourceString: 禁制机动队六队副队长

RoleDescText.SourceString:
用关键词描述一下在管理局里，大概没有人不认识的那位E.T.D六队副队长吧？
「善解人意」、「随和」、「开朗」、「古灵精怪」、「亲切」、「礼貌周全」、「风趣」、「温柔」……员工们各自一股脑地列出了形容词，都是用来描述讨人喜欢的性格特质。
虽然其中也有一些词汇的含义似乎微妙地冲突了，但不同的人之间会有小小的理解差异也是再自然不过的事，不用太放在心上啦。
大家至少都在同一条关键词上，达成了毋庸置疑的共识啊——「我的朋友」。
RoleDescText.LocalizedString:
How would you describe the ETD-6 Lieutenant—the one known by everyone at the Bureau—in just a few keywords?
"Considerate," "easygoing," "cheerful," "quirky," "warm," "courteous," "witty," "gentle"… The staff each rattled off adjectives—all traits that make someone easy to like.
Some of those characteristics might seem contradictory, but it's only natural that people see the same person a little differently. There's no need to overthink it.
At least everyone agreed upon one keyword: "my friend."

RoleDescText.SourceString:
「17F的兜帽鬼影」是管理局内曾小规模流传的一则……都市传说？
据说有个阴沉古怪、满脸死寂、总环绕着一股杀气的骇人家伙，就住在那层楼的小房间里，每天忙个不停，几乎足不出户……要是加班到深夜一片黑漆漆的时候，打开电梯门看到一个飘荡的、这样的东西浮现在走廊上，忍不住惊叫出声的话——
「抱歉，事故报告文件3分钟后发送至你的电脑桌面。」
请相信他真的不会介意此事，一点都不会。
RoleDescText.LocalizedString:
"The Hooded Phantom of 17F" was once a minor urban legend… within the Bureau?
They say a gloomy, strange figure with a horrifying blank expression and a menacing aura inhabits a room on that floor. The thing is always busy, and hardly ever leaves… If you're working late and open the elevator doors to find something floating in the hallway, chances are you'd let out a bloodcurdling scream—
"Sorry. The accident report file will be sent to your desktop in three minutes."
Believe me, he really doesn't mind. Not one bit.
